thread:
maria: Ran a quick end-to-end on mosaic-7b q8x4 across H100 (eu-west) and A100 (us-west). Numbers look weird for prefill p99. posting highlights and config snippets.

sahil: Can you paste the perf summary?

maria: H100 eu-west: prefill p50 18ms/token, p99 72ms; decode throughput ~2100 tokens/sec; $/1M tokens ≈ $8.20. A100 us-west: prefill p50 26ms, p99 120ms; decode ~1300 tps; $/1M tokens ≈ $6.90. KV cache hit steady ~65% (simulated sticky traffic).

ben: Interesting — H100 gives lower latency but higher $/1M because of region/sku price. what batch/seq settings?

maria: batch=dynamic (max 8), seq_len=1024, quant=q8x4. kernels: runtime auto -> fused-attn on H100, flash->fallback observed on A100 for long-prefill paths. Also saw some thermal counters elevated on the H100 node but no hard throttle.

olivia: Any kernel_fallback traces in the logs?

maria: yes, a small spike of `kernel_fallback` events around large prefill windows on A100. those coincide with p99 spikes (2-3x). example log snippet:

```
[2026-03-15T12:03:21Z] kernel_fallback: model=mosaic-7b seq=2048 reason=oom_or_missing_kernel path=decode
[2026-03-15T12:03:21Z] dispatch: fallback_kernel=flash_attn_v2
```

sahil: Can we force fast_attn on A100 to see if fallback is the main culprit?

maria: launched a quick job (id 4423456920) forcing `fast_attn=true` on A100. deploy-bot kicked it off.

deploy-bot: started job 4423456920 (maria) -> a100-fast_attn-compare

maria: Results: forcing fast_attn on A100 improved prefill p50 -> 20ms, p99 -> 85ms; decode ~1550 tps; $/1M now ≈ $7.50. Fewer fallback traces in logs. Still ~10-20% higher latency vs H100 eu-west, but much closer.

ben: So practical takeaway: H100 gives ~1.3x latency improvement and ~1.35x tokens/sec for this workload out of the box. A100 can approach H100 with kernel tuning but region pricing flips $/1M. Recommend we treat kernel enforcement/tuning as part of model bring-up checklist.

olivia: Also add GPU thermal telemetry + sustained power limit counters to the onboarding dashboard. p99 tail might be power-limit related in some racks.

maria: Agreed. I'll attach GPU telemetry and per-token cost breakdown in the doc. Quick diff table I'll paste in the ticket later. TL;DR: H100 = best latency; A100 = cheaper per-token in some regions unless you force faster kernels. KV cache hit rates and cache warm behavior also swing $/1M by ~10-25%.

sahil: +1. Follow-up: run H100 in us-west and A100 in eu-west to isolate region vs sku effects. Also run a high KV-hit variant (simulate 90% hits) to see steady-state $/1M.

maria: Scheduling both runs. Filed infra#3421 to track kernel gating + regional price integration into the cost estimator.

ben: Nice work. add a short note to the onboarding doc: "Run kernel-sensitivity sweep + region price check before enabling model for production."

maria: done. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
